description: Department of Labour - Notifying that the Cost of Living Index Number for the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade for the Month of February 2016 being 111.5, the Special Allowance in respect of a normal working day in the Month of March will be Rs. 624.21 and for the Month of March 2016 being 110.5, the Special Allowance in the Month of April will be Rs. 616.67
reasoning: This gazette notification announces a special allowance for workers in specific trades based on the Cost of Living Index Number, issued under the Wages Boards Ordinance. This falls under public sector service conditions and benefits administration, specifically addressing compensation adjustments for workers, which aligns with Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) that cover "Service conditions and benefits" and "Public service disciplinary matters."
